definition: `ProjectedIn x r`: x, a thrown body that does not move itself, continues in the local motion r after contact with the thrower has ceased (Aquinas, In Phys. VIII, lect. 22, n. 1160). Not identified with Newton's perseverance in uniform motion (DEF-NEWTONIAN-PERSEVERANCE): projection in a medium is neither uniform nor, for Aquinas, one continuous motion.
